tagline.en: Cleveland's Outerbelt East, with express lanes in the median
tagline.zh: 克利夫兰东外环：中央分隔带设快速车道

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 2, January 2026

start.en: I-71 in Medina Township, south-west of Cleveland
start.zh: 克利夫兰西南的梅迪纳镇，与 I-71 相接

end.en: I-90 at Willoughby Hills, east of Cleveland
end.zh: 克利夫兰以东的威洛比希尔斯，与 I-90 相接

en: I-271 is officially the Outerbelt East Freeway, though almost nobody calls it that; in Cleveland it is just 271. It runs from I-71 in Medina Township, well south-west of the city, north and then east through Richfield and the eastern suburbs to I-90 at Willoughby Hills, taking in Shaker Heights, Pepper Pike, Warrensville Heights and Bedford Heights. Its odd hundreds digit marks it as a spur off I-71 rather than a loop, and it is: it never returns to its parent.

Two things are unusual about it. For 5.84 miles it runs concurrently with I-480 — the only place in the system where two three-digit Interstates overlap. And between the I-480/US 422 junction and I-90 it has express lanes in the median, separated from the local lanes, a configuration more familiar from Chicago and Detroit than from a suburban outerbelt. They were added between 1993 and 1995 with related work finishing in 1998.
zh: I-271 的正式名称是「东外环高速」，但几乎无人这么叫；在克利夫兰，它就是「271」。它自城市西南远处梅迪纳镇的 I-71 起，向北再向东，经里奇菲尔德与东部各郊区，抵达威洛比希尔斯的 I-90，沿途涵盖沙克海茨、佩珀派克、沃伦斯维尔海茨与贝德福德海茨。奇数百位标示它是 I-71 的支线而非环线，事实也如此：它从未回到母线。
它有两点不寻常。有 5.84 英里与 I-480 共线——这是全系统中唯一两条三位数州际公路重叠的地方。另外，在 I-480／US 422 枢纽与 I-90 之间，它在中央分隔带内设有与地方车道分隔的快速车道，这种布置更常见于芝加哥与底特律，而非郊区外环。这些车道于 1993 至 1995 年间加建，相关工程到 1998 年完成。

en: The idea goes back to Cleveland's 1944 Express Highway Plan, which proposed an Outer Belt East running from Euclid south to Warrensville Heights. That corridor was built in stages through the 1960s and folded into the I-271 designation, which has existed since 1964; the route was substantially complete around 1971 to 1972. A companion route, I-290, would have paired with it on the north end but was cancelled, which is part of why I-271 shares pavement with I-480 instead.

The southern Cuyahoga County section, built in the 1960s, had recorded high congestion every year since 2003, and ODOT identified the need to widen it in March 2002. The rebuild eventually began in August 2016 and reached substantial completion in October 2020: six miles of new pavement, widened from two to three lanes each way between Miles Road and Columbus Road and from three to five between Columbus Road and the I-480 split, in eleven phases, for $120 million of state and federal money.
zh: 这个构想可追溯到克利夫兰 1944 年的《快速公路规划》，其中提出一条自欧几里得南下至沃伦斯维尔海茨的「东外环」。该走廊在 1960 年代分期建成，并被纳入 1964 年起启用的 I-271 编号；全线大致在 1971 至 1972 年间建成。原本还有一条 I-290 要在北端与它配对，后被取消——这也是 I-271 转而与 I-480 共用路面的原因之一。
库雅荷加县南段建于 1960 年代，自 2003 年起年年被记录为严重拥堵，俄亥俄州交通部在 2002 年 3 月确认了拓宽需求。重建最终于 2016 年 8 月开工，2020 年 10 月基本完工：六英里新路面，迈尔斯路至哥伦布路之间由每向两车道拓至三车道，哥伦布路至 I-480 分岔处由三车道拓至五车道，分十一期实施，动用州与联邦资金 1.2 亿美元。

why.en: The route was assembled from separately let Cleveland outerbelt contracts through the 1960s and Ohio's published histories give no consolidated total for I-271.
why.zh: 这条路线由 1960 年代分别发包的克利夫兰外环合同拼合而成，俄亥俄州已出版的史料未给出 I-271 的汇总造价。

timeline.en: Cleveland's Express Highway Plan proposes an Outer Belt East.
timeline.zh: 克利夫兰《快速公路规划》提出修建东外环。

timeline.en: The I-271 designation comes into use.
Express lanes in the median are finished between I-480 and I-90.
timeline.zh: I-480 与 I-90 之间中央分隔带内的快速车道完工。

timeline.en: The $120 million widening through southern Cuyahoga County reaches substantial completion.
timeline.zh: 库雅荷加县南段 1.2 亿美元拓宽工程基本完工。
